_: A restless hand: a tap on the water while the invitation shows (it builds the road it shows, and ripples), a tap on the west street and one on the east long road (a road is built between them), a slash across the west street (it closes behind a barrier; the drivers go round), a tap on the closed street (it opens), a road drawn up the middle from the way in to the way out, and a shake (the town's own roads back).
